Metadata.title: UAE Athletics Federation Dashboard
Metadata.description: Manage content and users for the UAE Athletics Federation digital platform

RolesWorkbench.title: Roles & permissions
RolesWorkbench.description: Every permission here guards a real API route, and a role is the only way to grant one to a person.
RolesWorkbench.tileCatalogueNote: across {resources} resources — derived from the code, not created here
RolesWorkbench.tileConsequentialNote: Delete, approve, publish or protected data
RolesWorkbench.tileRolelessNote: They can sign in and see nothing
RolesWorkbench.noRoleSelected: Pick a role to see what it permits.
RolesWorkbench.holders: {count, plural, =0 {No holders} one {1 holder} other {# holders}}
RolesWorkbench.permissionsGranted: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {1 permission} other {# permissions}}
RolesWorkbench.noDescription: No description recorded for this role.
RolesWorkbench.systemRoleBody: The platform relies on this role to run itself, so its name, its permissions and its existence are all fixed. Create a custom role if you need a different set.
RolesWorkbench.immediateBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds this role, so nobody is affected.} one {It applies to 1 person on their next request — no sign-in needed.} other {It applies to # people on their next request — no sign-in needed.}}
RolesWorkbench.blockedBody: {count, plural, one {This role holds 1 permission you do not hold yourself} other {This role holds # permissions you do not hold yourself}}, and the API refuses the save while they are in the list. Remove them to save, or ask to be granted them first.
RolesWorkbench.catalogueHiddenTitle: The permission catalogue is not available to you
RolesWorkbench.catalogueHiddenBody: Reading permissions is a separate grant from editing roles. You can see the roles, but the matrix needs the read-permissions grant.
RolesWorkbench.cannotGrant: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot grant it
RolesWorkbench.legendLocked: A disabled box is a permission you do not hold
RolesWorkbench.legendAbsent: An em dash means the permission does not exist for that resource
RolesWorkbench.save_ok: The change applies to everyone holding this role from now.
RolesWorkbench.save_systemRole: This is a system role and cannot be edited.
RolesWorkbench.save_ungrantablePermission: The list includes a permission you do not hold.
RolesWorkbench.save_selfAssignment: You cannot make this change to your own account.
RolesWorkbench.save_forbidden: You do not have permission to edit roles.
RolesWorkbench.save_notFound: This role no longer exists. Reload the page.
RolesWorkbench.save_invalidRequest: The request was rejected. Reload and try again.
RolesWorkbench.save_tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
RolesWorkbench.save_conflict: The data conflicts. Reload and try again.
RolesWorkbench.save_sessionExpired: Your session ended and the permissions were not saved. Reload the page and sign in again.
RolesWorkbench.save_serviceUnavailable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
RolesWorkbench.descriptionHint: Optional. Shown beside the name wherever the role is assigned — a name alone does not tell whoever is handing out access what the role actually permits.
RolesWorkbench.createHint: The role is created with no permissions. Grant them from the matrix afterwards.
RolesWorkbench.createdBody: It holds no permissions yet. Select it from the list and grant what it needs.
RolesWorkbench.detailsSavedBody: The new name and description apply everywhere this role appears.
RolesWorkbench.archiveBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds this role, so nobody loses access.} one {1 person holds it and loses everything it grants, immediately.} other {# people hold it and lose everything it grants, immediately.}} The role is removed from every account holding it, and this screen cannot undo it.
RolesWorkbench.archivedBody: It is no longer listed and no longer grants anything.
RolesWorkbench.save_impliedReadMissing: Not saved: the role grants a change to a resource without permission to read it. The screen ticks the read automatically — check what was unticked by hand.
RolesWorkbench.impliedBody: Whoever may change a resource must be able to read it. The read permission was ticked for you, and is now visible in the matrix.
RolesWorkbench.incoherentBody: These resources are ticked for change but not for read, and the save will be refused: {resources}
RolesWorkbench.catalogueNote: Every permission here guards a real API route, and the list is derived from the source itself. Permissions are not created here: a new row would create one that guards nothing.
RolesWorkbench.catalogueCaption: Every permission on the platform, and who holds it.

UsersDirectory.title: Users
UsersDirectory.description: The accounts that can sign in to the dashboard, and the roles assigned to them. The role decides what the account holder sees.
UsersDirectory.tileRolelessNote: They can sign in and see nothing
UsersDirectory.caption: Dashboard accounts
UsersDirectory.cannotEditSelf: You cannot change the roles on your own account
UsersDirectory.noRolesToAssign: There are no roles to assign.
UsersDirectory.assign_selfAssignment: You cannot assign roles to your own account.
UsersDirectory.assign_forbidden: You do not have permission to edit users.
UsersDirectory.assign_notFound: This account no longer exists. Reload the page.
UsersDirectory.assign_invalidRequest: The request was rejected. Reload and try again.
UsersDirectory.assign_tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
UsersDirectory.assign_conflict: The data conflicts. Reload and try again.
UsersDirectory.assign_ungrantablePermission: You do not hold enough permissions for this assignment.
UsersDirectory.assign_sessionExpired: Your session ended and the roles were not saved. Reload the page and sign in again.
UsersDirectory.assign_serviceUnavailable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
UsersDirectory.readOnlyBody: You can see the accounts, but changing roles needs the update-users grant.
UsersDirectory.rolesHiddenTitle: Role names are not available to you
UsersDirectory.rolesHiddenBody: Reading roles is a separate grant from reading users. The accounts are listed, but their roles cannot be named without it.
UsersDirectory.statusNoChange: The current status. Pick a different one to enable the button.
UsersDirectory.statusEndsSessions: This ends every open session for the account immediately, and its holder will not be able to sign in.
UsersDirectory.cannotEditOwnStatus: You cannot change the status of your own account. Ask another administrator.
UsersDirectory.status_selfAssignment: You cannot change your own account's status.
UsersDirectory.status_forbidden: You do not have permission to edit users.
UsersDirectory.status_notFound: This account no longer exists. Reload the page.
UsersDirectory.status_invalidRequest: Unrecognised status. Reload and try again.
UsersDirectory.status_tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
UsersDirectory.status_conflict: The data conflicts. Reload and try again.
UsersDirectory.status_ungrantablePermission: You do not hold enough permissions for this change.
UsersDirectory.status_sessionExpired: Your session ended and the status did not change. Reload the page and sign in again.
UsersDirectory.status_serviceUnavailable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
UsersDirectory.emailHint: This is the sign-in name, and it cannot be changed from this screen.
UsersDirectory.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Hand it over through a secure channel — it is not shown again after the account is created.
UsersDirectory.rolesHint: An account with no role can sign in and see nothing. You can assign them later.
UsersDirectory.personHint: Optional. Links the account to its record in federation personnel.
UsersDirectory.personHiddenHint: Reading federation personnel is a separate grant, so the list cannot be shown here.
UsersDirectory.createdBody: {name} can sign in now with the email and password you entered.
UsersDirectory.createConflict: That email is already registered to another account.
UsersDirectory.assign_impliedReadMissing: That role is not coherent: it changes a resource it cannot read. Fix it on the access screen first.
UsersDirectory.status_impliedReadMissing: That role is not coherent: it changes a resource it cannot read. Fix it on the access screen first.

SitePages.description: The pages whose content is fixed: one headline and standfirst each, shown above the public page before its changing content.
SitePages.emptyHint: The public page shows an empty header until this is filled in.
SitePages.imageHidden: Reading media is a separate grant, so the library cannot be shown here. The current image is kept as it is.
SitePages.missingFields: Fill the required fields in both Arabic and English.
SitePages.noImages: There are no images in the library yet.
SitePages.noPageSelected: Pick a page to edit its content.
SitePages.readOnlyBody: You can see this page's content, but editing it needs the update grant.
SitePages.savedBody: The new content appears on the public site immediately — these pages carry no approval or publication step.
SitePages.tileEmptyNote: Their header is empty on the public site
SitePages.title: Site pages
SitePages.uploadAltHint: Describes the picture for anyone who cannot see it. Required.
SitePages.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded.
SitePages.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
SitePages.uploadNeedsAlt: Alternative text is required in both languages.
